title: L10 half: the truncating sed -n help range is gone but the shared print_help was never created, so the one-line sentinel extractor is now hand-copied twelve times in three incompatible shapes, eight keeping the leading '# ' and three stripping it
both checkers now source _edm-lint-lib.sh and call the shared build_line_classes, which de-indents and matches fences by run length, so the column-1 anchoring divergence cannot recur

the VERBATIM mirror comments are gone from both checkers but the assertion guarding them still greps for build_ignore_set, which exists nowhere in the tree, and its label still claims edm-check-grants mirrors rather than sources the helpers

the abolished legacy scale is gone and the code-audit skill's table is deleted, but the synthesizer and srd-auditor still restate an abridged scale that drops 'missing requirement' from P1 and 'architecturally wrong' from P0, directly under a sentence forbidding restatement

the scorer's Mermaid rule body was brought into agreement by cloning the canonical awk verbatim rather than extracting bin/edm-mermaid-rules.awk, leaving a 45-line unguarded duplicate whose fence recognition is still column-1 anchored and which honours no edm-lint-ignore marker

each pinned digest now appears exactly once behind the .alpine_edm and the new .node_edm anchor, and validate:manifest, validate:plugin-cli and eval:nightly all consume an anchor rather than respelling a digest

_harness.sh still exports no _HARNESS_PLUGIN_DIR or _HARNESS_REPO_ROOT, so PLUGIN_DIR is still derived four different ways across the suites with wave4b the only copy keyed on $0, five suites still re-compute inline the value assigned a line above, and three byte-identical TMP/trap triples still diverge from wave6/wave7's hygiene

the shared library was created and is genuinely sourced by edm-lint-artifacts, edm-check-grants and edm-check-vocabulary, with build_line_classes, is_ignored_line and report_violation defined in exactly one place and no surviving hand-copy in bin/

audit_required_for_mode_or_legacy was extracted and is consumed by both convergence_exempt and cmd_approve_gate, the third inline copy is gone, and the stale 'mirrors cmd_archive' comment was replaced by an accurate note on the deliberate split

seven independent whole-tree --all lint scans and thirteen whole-tree edm-check-grants runs still execute in one suite with nothing mutating the tree between them; no grants capture was added and the lint capture is still declared below seven of its potential consumers

all eleven lens definitions still cite skills/code-audit/SKILL.md:40 for a mkdir -p that moved from line 45 to line 59 during remediation, so the one duplicated fact drifted a further fourteen lines in eleven places at once; edm-check-grants:13 and :335 remain stale too

the same standalone-checker invocation block still appears twice differing only in script name, variable prefix and label, and the predicted cost has landed: edm-check-vocabulary, the third standalone checker, is not invoked by the aggregator at all

ignored_line_set is a byte-identical four-line copy in edm-check-grants and edm-check-vocabulary and is derived a third way inline in edm-lint-artifacts, so build_line_classes' tab-separated record shape now has three independent parsers outside the shared library

the shared report_violation branches on two spellings of the violation counter because edm-check-grants declares VIOLATIONS while the other two declare violations, so a caller declaring neither has its findings printed and counted nowhere and the script exits 0 on a dirty tree

the ignore set is deliberately not applied to grant source 2 because the lens launch template lives inside a fence; rationale unaffected by the shared-library extraction, carried forward on round 1 evidence without re-walking every call site

edm-check-grants' actor-first output shape remains deliberate and required by its own AC7; only the arity-based dispatch now expressing it inside the shared library is criticised, and that is filed separately

the lens JSONL skeleton is still deliberately not factored to a single reference and still shows zero drift across the eleven copies; the cheap insurance of a byte-identity smoke assertion still does not exist
lint:pattern-library-contract duplicating the smoke suite's four-heading check remains deliberate and documented; carried forward on round 1's rule-by-rule comparison, not re-diffed this round
